article.title: October 2026 (Volume 78, Number 5)
article.author: Jamil Jonna
article.content: Marking the sixtieth anniversary of Paul A. Baran and Paul M. Sweezy’s Monopoly Capital , the MR editors situates this key work of political economy within the contemporary political-economic landscape. The tendency toward the overaccumulation capital, they explain, represents a shift from the “ generation of economic surplus…to one of its absorption .” In an age of financialization and market bubbles, the editors note, Baran and Sweezy’s work stands as a testament to the continuing necessity of incisive political-economic analysis of capitalism, inequality, and the irrationality that pervading the entire system. The post October 2026 (Volume 78, Number 5) appeared first on Monthly Review .
